about_the_game:
Fight. Survive. Escape.

Step into the boots of a lone knight trapped deep within a forgotten dungeon, overrun by vicious orc hordes. Tombs & Trials is a fast-paced 2D top-down dungeon crawler where survival is earned one wave at a time.

Battle your way through relentless waves of orcs—each type deadlier than the last—as you push deeper into the twisting labyrinth in search of freedom. Slash, dodge, and strategize as you uncover secrets, gather loot, and unlock your path to the surface.

Features

  • Intense wave-based combat with a variety of orc enemies

  • Classic top-down action with modern controls

  • Powerful weapons and upgrades to aid your escape

  • Dark dungeon atmosphere and retro-inspired visuals

  • One goal: escape the dungeon… or die trying

Can you survive the onslaught and reclaim the light?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Vulkan or OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple Silicon (M1+)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
